notes: Ranked online with an Elo leaderboard, instant Hoops shots online, and a new title screen. Everyone starts at 1000 Elo: win online 1-on-1s (fights or Hoops) to climb. Hoops online: your jump shot plays the moment you press, with no delay to fight. The green shrinks the farther out you are and when a defender jumps right on you. CPUs can now double dribble. Rebirth 4 gives mediums their own impact frame; rebirth 5 unlocks the gold Ascended Super. Rebirth XP is +0.5x per rebirth now, max 2 levels a fight. Smarter clones. Global chat pop-ups, see who's online and invite them with no code. Name and menu tour for new players. Updates show up in the game on their own.
